SupermainQuest6.title: Complete 6 main quests
SupermainQuest6.rewardText: Congratulations! You've helped 6 partners! There are plenty of missions left on the archipelago, so keep exploring!

SupermainQuest12.title: Complete 12 main quests
SupermainQuest12.rewardText: Great! You've helped a lot of partners again, only 4 more to go!

SupermainQuest16.title: Complete 16 main quests
SupermainQuest16.rewardText: Great job! You've helped out everyone with their missions. Keep exploring to earn more Data B-each Points!

AspirationMain.title: TECH COMPANY #2
AspirationMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #2
and water a tree.
AspirationMain.rewardText: Yeah! There are still {{actorCounts.GrowableTree - 1}} seedlings to water all around the islands. Use your watering can when you are nearby. Find them all to earn more Data B-each Points!

AvenMain.title: TECH COMPANY #3
AvenMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #3
to renovate a house.
AvenMain.rewardText: Well done! There are {{actorCounts.AvenHouse - 1}} other houses to find on the islands. Renovate them to unlock more Data B-each Points.

BluevineMain.title: TECH COMPANY #4
BluevineMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #4
to open a new coffee shop.
BluevineMain.rewardText: Great job! Keep your eyes open, there is a chest on the island, next to the coffee shop.

BrigitMain.title: TECH COMPANY #1
BrigitMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #1
and participate in a
bike race.
BrigitMain.rewardText: Congratulations! Come back anytime and finish your lap in less than {{gameGoals.CircuitBike}} seconds to unlock more Data B-each Points.

CoastalMain.title: TECH COMPANY #14
CoastalMain.description:
Talk to TECH COMPANY #14
and participate
in a car race.
CoastalMain.rewardText: What a pilot! Come back anytime and finish your lap in less than {{gameGoals.CircuitCar}} seconds to unlock more Data B-each Points.

GreenwoodMain.title: TECH COMPANY #5
GreenwoodMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #5
to turn on the speakers.
GreenwoodMain.rewardText: Awesome! There are {{actorCounts.Speakers - 1}} other speakers to find on the islands. Turn them on to unlock more Data B-each Points and bring cool music on Data B-each!

KikoffMain.title: TECH COMPANY #10
KikoffMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #10
and turn on a lighthouse.
KikoffMain.rewardText: Fabulous! Find the {{actorCounts.Lighthouse - 1}} other lighthouses on the islands, and light them on to unlock more Data B-each Points.

LendingpointMain.title: Cheese
LendingpointMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #13
to open a shop.
LendingpointMain.rewardText: Great job! There are {{actorCounts.ShopForSale - 1}} other shops throughout the islands. Open their storefronts to unlock more Data B-each Points.

OneMain.title: TECH COMPANY #7
OneMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #7
and participate
in a boat race.
OneMain.rewardText: Hey sailor! Come back anytime and finish your lap in less than {{gameGoals.CircuitBoat}} seconds to unlock more Data B-each Points.

PomeloMain.title: TECH COMPANY #8
PomeloMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #8
to build the bridge.
PomeloMain.rewardText: Nice! Keep your eyes open, there are chests on the island, next to the house.

PossibleMain.title: TECH COMPANY #12
PossibleMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #12
to use a zipline
PossibleMain.rewardText: Well done! There are {{computedCounts.ZiplineLinks - 1}} other ziplines to find on the islands. Use them to unlock more Data B-each Points.

ProsperMain.title: TECH COMPANY #11
ProsperMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #11
to plant a flag.
ProsperMain.rewardText: Great job! Plant a flag on the {{actorCounts.FlagPole - 1}} highest points of the archipelago to unlock more Data B-each Points.

TempkeyMain.title: Secret Resort
TempkeyMain.rewardText: Great job! Keep your eyes open, there is a chest nearby.

TillMain.rewardText: Great job! Keep your eyes open, there are chests on the island, next to the skatepark.

X1Main.rewardText: What a pilot! Come back anytime and finish your lap in less than {{gameGoals.CircuitJetski}} seconds to unlock more Data B-each Points.

ZendaMain.title: TECH COMPANY #9
ZendaMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #9,
and aid someone in pain.
ZendaMain.rewardText: So nice! There is {{actorCounts.CitizenSick - 1}} other people that need assistance on the islands. Help them and you'll be rewarded with more Data B-each Points!
